records.jp: 小さい頃は、ブランコをこぐ時、<CR>お姉ちゃんに背中を押してもらってたっけ
records.en_original: I think my big sister used to push me on the swings when I was little.
records.en_auxiliary: I think my big sister used to push me on the swings when I was little.
records.en: When I was little, Onee-chan<CR>used to push me on the swings.

records.jp: 美弦さんとはよく一緒に遊んだの？
records.en_original: Did you and Mio play together a lot?
records.en_auxiliary: Did you and Mio play together a lot?
records.en: Did you and Mio-san play together a lot?

records.jp: はっきりとは覚えてないけど、<CR>よく構ってもらった気がするんだ
records.en_original: I don't remember it very clearly, but I feel like she was always looking after me.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't remember it very clearly, but I feel like she was always looking after me.
records.en: I don't remember it very clearly, but I<CR>feel like she was always looking after me.

records.jp: お姉ちゃんは昔から優しかったから
records.en_original: She's always been so kind.
records.en_auxiliary: She's always been so kind.
records.en: Onee-chan has always been kind.

records.jp: 昔から仲良しなんだね
records.en_original: So you two have been close since back then.
records.en_auxiliary: So you two have been close since back then.
records.en: So you two have been close since back then.

records.jp: うん。いろんなことをしてもらったなあ。<CR>迷惑もいろいろかけたかも
records.en_original: Yeah. She's done so much for me. I must have caused her a lot of trouble.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. She's done so much for me. I must have caused her a lot of trouble.
records.en: Yeah. She's done so much for me. I must have<CR>caused her a lot of trouble.

records.jp: だから、ちゃんと自立してお姉ちゃんが自分のために<CR>時間を使えるようにしなきゃなって思ってる
records.en_original: That's why I need to become more independent, so my sister can spend her time on herself.
records.en_auxiliary: That's why I need to become more independent, so my sister can spend her time on herself.
records.en: That is why I need to become independent, so<CR>Onee-chan can spend time on herself.

records.jp: なんだかいいなあ。<CR>姉妹の絆って感じで
records.en_original: I love that. It sounds like you have a great sisterly bond.
records.en_auxiliary: I love that. It sounds like you have a great sisterly bond.
records.en: I love that. It sounds like you<CR>have a great sisterly bond.

records.jp: なんか……ちょっとうらやましいな……
records.en_original: Aww... I'm kinda jealous...
records.en_auxiliary: Aww... I'm kinda jealous...
records.en: Aww... I'm kinda jealous...

records.jp: うらやましい？
records.en_original: Jealous?
records.en_auxiliary: Jealous?
records.en: Jealous?

records.jp: あっ……えっと……
records.en_original: Oh... Um...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh... Um...
records.en: Oh... Um...

records.jp: たしかにお姉ちゃんは本当に素敵だからね！<CR>えへへっ
records.en_original: I mean, Mio sure sounds like a great person! Ehehe...
records.en_auxiliary: I mean, Mio sure sounds like a great person! Ehehe...
records.en: That is true—Onee-chan really is wonderful!<CR>Ehehe.

records.jp: （……美弦さんと陽桜莉さんって、<CR>かたーい絆で結ばれた姉妹って感じだよね）
records.en_original: (Hiori and Mio have a really strong sisterly bond...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hiori and Mio have a really strong sisterly bond...)
records.en: (Hiori-san and Mio-san have<CR>a really strong sisterly bond...)

records.jp: （……いいなぁ。私のことを誰かに話す時も、<CR>陽桜莉さんがこういう顔をしてくれたらなぁ）
records.en_original: (That's sweet. I wish she looked like that when talking about me...)
records.en_auxiliary: (That's sweet. I wish she looked like that when talking about me...)
records.en: (That is nice... I wish Hiori-san would make that<CR>face when she talks to someone about me too.)

records.jp: ……？　ど、どうしたの愛央ちゃん？<CR>じっと見つめられると照れちゃうよ
records.en_original: ...? Wh-what's the matter, Ao? You're just staring at me...
records.en_auxiliary: ...? Wh-what's the matter, Ao? You're just staring at me...
records.en: ...? Wh-what's the matter, Ao-chan?<CR>You're just staring at me...

records.jp: ごめんごめん。何でもないの
records.en_original: Sorry, sorry. It's nothing.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry, sorry. It's nothing.
records.en: Sorry, sorry. It's nothing.

records.jp: そういえば愛央ちゃんは一人っ子だっけ？
records.en_original: Are you an only child, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you an only child, Ao?
records.en: Are you an only child, Ao-chan?

records.jp: お姉ちゃんか妹、欲しかった？
records.en_original: Did you ever wish you had an older or younger sister?
records.en_auxiliary: Did you ever wish you had an older or younger sister?
records.en: Did you ever wish you had an older or younger sister?

records.jp: どっちかと言えばお姉ちゃんが欲しかったかも
records.en_original: If I had to choose, I guess I'd want a big sister.
records.en_auxiliary: If I had to choose, I guess I'd want a big sister.
records.en: If I had to choose, I guess I'd want an older sister.

records.jp: やっぱり甘えたい感じ？
records.en_original: You want someone to take care of you?
records.en_auxiliary: You want someone to take care of you?
records.en: You want someone to take care of you?

records.jp: かなあ。宿題を教えてもらったりとか……<CR>たまに服を貸してもらったりとか
records.en_original: Maybe. Someone to help me with my homework...or that I could borrow clothes from...
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe. Someone to help me with my homework...or that I could borrow clothes from...
records.en: Maybe. Someone to help me with my homework...or<CR>that I could borrow clothes from...

records.jp: あはは、そういうのも楽しいよね！
records.en_original: Ahaha, I know what you mean!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, I know what you mean!
records.en: Ahaha, I know what you mean!

records.jp: うちの場合、お姉ちゃんと似合う服のタイプが<CR>全然違ったから難しかったけど……
records.en_original: But my sister and I had totally different styles, so we couldn't really do that...
records.en_auxiliary: But my sister and I had totally different styles, so we couldn't really do that...
records.en: In our case, Onee-chan and I looked good in completely different<CR>kinds of clothes, so sharing was difficult...

records.jp: 妹がいたら楽しそうだなぁ。<CR>髪とか結んであげたりして
records.en_original: Having a little sister would be fun. I could do her hair and stuff!
records.en_auxiliary: Having a little sister would be fun. I could do her hair and stuff!
records.en: Having a younger sister would be fun.<CR>I could do her hair and stuff!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、優しいお姉ちゃんになりそう！
records.en_original: You'd be a really nice big sister!
records.en_auxiliary: You'd be a really nice big sister!
records.en: You'd make a kind older sister, Ao-chan!

records.jp: たまにおつかい頼んだりとか。<CR>コンビニで肉まん買ってこーいって
records.en_original: And I could ask her to do things for me. Like, "go to the store and get me a snack!"
records.en_auxiliary: And I could ask her to do things for me. Like, "go to the store and get me a snack!"
records.en: I could sometimes send her on errands too.<CR>“Go buy me a steamed meat bun from the convenience store!”

records.jp: そうでもなかった
records.en_original: ...Or not.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Or not.
records.en: ...Or not.

records.jp: まあ、本当に姉妹がいたら<CR>大変なことも多いとは思うけどさ
records.en_original: But if I really did have a sister, I doubt it would be a walk in the park.
records.en_auxiliary: But if I really did have a sister, I doubt it would be a walk in the park.
records.en: But if I really did have a sister,<CR>I doubt it would be a walk in the park.

records.jp: そう……だね。<CR>近い存在だからこそ、ってことはあるかも
records.en_original: Yeah... Having someone that close to you has its own challenges.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... Having someone that close to you has its own challenges.
records.en: Yeah... Having<CR>someone that close to you has its own challenges.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんは妹が欲しいって<CR>思ったことはないの？
records.en_original: Have you ever wanted a little sister, Hiori?
records.en_auxiliary: Have you ever wanted a little sister, Hiori?
records.en: Have you ever wanted a younger<CR>sister, Hiori-san?

records.jp: 私に妹がいたら？
records.en_original: A little sister?
records.en_auxiliary: A little sister?
records.en: A younger sister?

records.jp: そういえば全然考えたことないや。<CR>妹……妹……
records.en_original: I guess I've never thought about it... A little sister...
records.en_auxiliary: I guess I've never thought about it... A little sister...
records.en: I guess I've never thought about it... A<CR>younger sister...

records.jp: うん。もし妹がいるなら、<CR>愛央ちゃんみたいな妹が欲しいかな
records.en_original: I guess if I had a little sister, I'd want a little sister like you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess if I had a little sister, I'd want a little sister like you, Ao.
records.en: I guess if I had a younger sister,<CR>I'd want a younger sister like you, Ao-chan.

records.jp: えっ、私？
records.en_original: Huh, like me?!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, like me?!
records.en: Huh, like me?!

records.jp: 今日みたいに一緒に仲良く遊んだりして。<CR>きっと仲良し姉妹になれたと思うんだ
records.en_original: We'd play together all the time just like we did today! I'm sure we'd be really close sisters.
records.en_auxiliary: We'd play together all the time just like we did today! I'm sure we'd be really close sisters.
records.en: We'd play together all the time just like we did<CR>today! I'm sure we'd be really close sisters.

records.jp: ありがとう、陽桜莉お姉ちゃん！
records.en_original: Thanks, big sis!
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks, big sis!
records.en: Thank you, Hiori-oneechan!

records.jp: おー！　なんかいいね！<CR>ちょっとくすぐったいけど……アリ！
records.en_original: Oh! I kind of like that! It sounds a little strange...but I could get used to it!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh! I kind of like that! It sounds a little strange...but I could get used to it!
records.en: Oh! I kind of like that! It sounds<CR>a little strange...but I could get used to it!

records.jp: よ～し、妹よ。<CR>どっちが多くブランコをこげるか勝負だ～
records.en_original: All right, little sis. Let's see who can swing the highest!
records.en_auxiliary: All right, little sis. Let's see who can swing the highest!
records.en: All right, my younger sister.<CR>Let's see who can swing the highest!

records.jp: えー、やだよ！<CR>お姉ちゃん実は体力えぐいし！
records.en_original: What? That's not fair! You're stronger than me, big sis!
records.en_auxiliary: What? That's not fair! You're stronger than me, big sis!
records.en: No way!<CR>Your stamina is actually insane, Onee-chan!

records.jp: じゃあ始めるよ～
records.en_original: Here we go!
records.en_auxiliary: Here we go!
records.en: Here we go!

records.jp: 聞いてない！<CR>陽桜莉さんの妹やるのは大変だな！？
records.en_original: You're not even listening! Being your little sister is hard!
records.en_auxiliary: You're not even listening! Being your little sister is hard!
records.en: You're not listening!<CR>Being your younger sister would be hard, Hiori-san!

records.jp: えへへ……ちょっと照れちゃうなあ。<CR>そう言ってもらえるのは嬉しいけどさ
records.en_original: Ehehe... I'm not sure how I feel about that. But I'm glad to hear you say it.
records.en_auxiliary: Ehehe... I'm not sure how I feel about that. But I'm glad to hear you say it.
records.en: Ehehe... I'm not sure how I feel about<CR>that. But I'm glad to hear you say it.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、かわいー。<CR>頬っぺた赤くなってるよ
records.en_original: Your cheeks are all red, Ao! It's so cute!
records.en_auxiliary: Your cheeks are all red, Ao! It's so cute!
records.en: Your cheeks are all red,<CR>Ao-chan! It's so cute!

records.jp: えっ、うそ
records.en_original: R-really?
records.en_auxiliary: R-really?
records.en: R-really?

records.jp: ほんと。ツンツンしていい？
records.en_original: Yep. Can I pinch them?
records.en_auxiliary: Yep. Can I pinch them?
records.en: Really. Can I poke them?

records.jp: だ、だめ！<CR>もー、なんか本当に恥ずかしくなってきた
records.en_original: N-no! Ugh, I'm so embarrassed!
records.en_auxiliary: N-no! Ugh, I'm so embarrassed!
records.en: N-no!<CR>Ugh, I'm so embarrassed!

records.jp: ツンツンがだめなら、ぎゅ～ってしちゃお！
records.en_original: Well if I can't pinch your cheeks, I'll just have to squeeze you tight!
records.en_auxiliary: Well if I can't pinch your cheeks, I'll just have to squeeze you tight!
records.en: If I cannot poke them, I will just hug you tight!

records.jp: ぎゅ……ぎゅ～はもっとだめ～！
records.en_original: Th-that's even worse!
records.en_auxiliary: Th-that's even worse!
records.en: Th-that's even worse!

records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
